description.value: Pizza Pizzeria is a neighborhood fast-food spot in Burnaby's East 10th corridor serving a fusion of classic and Indian-influenced pizzas alongside a full Indian menu. Cyclists will find an unusually diverse selection ranging from Butter Chicken and Butter Paneer pizzas to palak dishes, samosas, mango lassi, and masala tea. The blend of quick-service pizza and hearty Indian comfort food offers practical refueling choices for riders with varied dietary needs.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pizzapizzeria.ca loaded successfully and corroborates the OSM phone number (+1 604-549-0049) and address (8679 E10th Ave, Burnaby BC). The menu confirms an operating fast-food pizza and Indian cuisine restaurant with explicit vegetarian and gluten-free options noted on the Palak Chana dish. No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, or washrooms — are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, leaving all required criteria unconfirmed.
concerns: OSM name 'Pizza Pizzria' appears to be a typo; website and branding consistently use 'Pizza Pizzeria'.
OSM address records 'Tenth Avenue' while website uses 'E10th Ave' — likely the same street but may warrant standardization in the directory.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate operating food business with diverse menu options including vegetarian and GF items, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct outreach is needed before listing.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website lists a dedicated Vegetarian pizza, vegetarian samosa, and explicitly states 'Gluten- and dairy-free options available' for the Palak Chana dish
